chcp 65001 >nul

    echo กำลังเปิดใช้งาน Virtual Environment...

# DiffSinger (OpenVPI maintained version)

[![arXiv](https://img.shields.io/badge/arXiv-Paper-<COLOR>.svg)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.02446)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/openvpi/DiffSinger/total.svg)](https://github.com/openvpi/DiffSinger/releases)
[![Bilibili](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bilibili-Demo-blue)](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1be411N7JA/)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/openvpi/DiffSinger/blob/main/LICENSE)

This is a refactored and enhanced version of _DiffSinger: Singing Voice Synthesis via Shallow Diffusion Mechanism_ based on the original [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.02446) and [implementation](https://github.com/MoonInTheRiver/DiffSinger), which provides:

- Cleaner code structure: useless and redundant files are removed and the others are re-organized.
- Better sound quality: the sampling rate of synthesized audio are adapted to 44.1 kHz instead of the original 24 kHz.
- Higher fidelity: improved acoustic models and diffusion sampling acceleration algorithms are integrated.
- More controllability: introduced variance models and parameters for prediction and control of pitch, energy, breathiness, etc.
- Production compatibility: functionalities are designed to match the requirements of production deployment and the SVS communities.

|                                       Overview                                        |                                    Variance Model                                     |                                    Acoustic Model                                     |
|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------:|
| <img src="docs/resources/arch-overview.jpg" alt="arch-overview" style="zoom: 60%;" /> | <img src="docs/resources/arch-variance.jpg" alt="arch-variance" style="zoom: 50%;" /> | <img src="docs/resources/arch-acoustic.jpg" alt="arch-acoustic" style="zoom: 60%;" /> |

## User Guidance

> 中文教程 / Chinese Tutorials: [Text](https://openvpi-docs.feishu.cn/wiki/KmBFwoYDEixrS4kHcTAcajPinPe), [Video](https://space.bilibili.com/179281251/channel/collectiondetail?sid=1747910)

- **Installation & basic usages**: See [Getting Started](docs/GettingStarted.md)
- **Dataset creation pipelines & tools**: See [MakeDiffSinger](https://github.com/openvpi/MakeDiffSinger)
- **Best practices & tutorials**: See [Best Practices](docs/BestPractices.md)
- **Editing configurations**: See [Configuration Schemas](docs/ConfigurationSchemas.md)
- **Deployment & production**: [OpenUTAU for DiffSinger](https://github.com/xunmengshe/OpenUtau), [DiffScope (under development)](https://github.com/openvpi/diffscope)
- **Communication groups**: [QQ Group](http://qm.qq.com/cgi-bin/qm/qr?_wv=1027&k=fibG_dxuPW5maUJwe9_ya5-zFcIwaoOR&authKey=ZgLCG5EqQVUGCID1nfKei8tCnlQHAmD9koxebFXv5WfUchhLwWxb52o1pimNai5A&noverify=0&group_code=907879266) (907879266), [Discord server](https://discord.gg/wwbu2JUMjj)

## References

### Original Paper & Implementation

- Paper: [DiffSinger: Singing Voice Synthesis via Shallow Diffusion Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.02446)
- Implementation: [MoonInTheRiver/DiffSinger](https://github.com/MoonInTheRiver/DiffSinger)

### Generative Models & Algorithms

- Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM): [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.11239), [implementation](https://github.com/hojonathanho/diffusion)
  - [DDIM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.02502) for diffusion sampling acceleration
  - [PNDM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.09778) for diffusion sampling acceleration
  - [DPM-Solver++](https://github.com/LuChengTHU/dpm-solver) for diffusion sampling acceleration
  - [UniPC](https://github.com/wl-zhao/UniPC) for diffusion sampling acceleration
- Rectified Flow (RF): [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.03003), [implementation](https://github.com/gnobitab/RectifiedFlow)

### Dependencies & Submodules

- [RoPE](https://github.com/lucidrains/rotary-embedding-torch) for transformer encoder
- [HiFi-GAN](https://github.com/jik876/hifi-gan) and [NSF](https://github.com/nii-yamagishilab/project-NN-Pytorch-scripts/tree/master/project/01-nsf) for waveform reconstruction
- [pc-ddsp](https://github.com/yxlllc/pc-ddsp) for waveform reconstruction
- [RMVPE](https://github.com/Dream-High/RMVPE) and yxlllc's [fork](https://github.com/yxlllc/RMVPE) for pitch extraction
- [Vocal Remover](https://github.com/tsurumeso/vocal-remover) and yxlllc's [fork](https://github.com/yxlllc/vocal-remover) for harmonic-noise separation

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def get_timestamp():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")


def log_msg(msg, level="INFO"):
    icons = {"INFO": "ℹ️", "OK": "✅", "WARN": "⚠️", "ERROR": "❌", "RUN": "🔄"}
    icon = icons.get(level, "📌")
    return f"[{get_timestamp()}] {icon} {msg}"


def append_log(log_text, new_msg):
    if log_text:
        return log_text + "\n" + new_msg
    return new_msg


def safe_yaml_dump(data):
    return yaml.dump(data, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)


def get_python_executable():
    """Get the Python executable, preferring the venv."""
    venv_python = ROOT_DIR / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"
    if venv_python.exists():
        return str(venv_python)
    venv_python_unix = ROOT_DIR / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"
    if venv_python_unix.exists():
        return str(venv_python_unix)
    return sys.executable


def run_subprocess_streaming(cmd, cwd=None):
    """Run a subprocess and yield output lines in real-time."""
    global _active_process
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(ROOT_DIR)
    env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED'] = '1'

    try:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            cwd=cwd or str(ROOT_DIR),
            env=env,
            text=True,
            bufsize=1,
            encoding='utf-8',
            errors='replace',
            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP if os.name == 'nt' else 0
        )
        with _process_lock:
            _active_process = process

        output = ""
        for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
            if line:
                output += line
                yield output

        process.wait()
        ret = process.returncode
        if ret == 0:
            output += f"\n{log_msg('Process completed successfully!', 'OK')}\n"
        else:
            output += f"\n{log_msg(f'Process exited with code {ret}', 'ERROR')}\n"
        yield output

    except Exception as e:
        yield f"{log_msg(f'Error: {str(e)}', 'ERROR')}\n"
    finally:
        with _process_lock:
            _active_process = None


def stop_active_process():
    """Stop the currently running subprocess."""
    global _active_process
    with _process_lock:
        if _active_process and _active_process.poll() is None:
            try:
                if os.name == 'nt':
                    _active_process.send_signal(signal.CTRL_BREAK_EVENT)
                else:
                    _active_process.terminate()
                _active_process.wait(timeout=10)
                return log_msg("Process stopped successfully.", "OK")
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                _active_process.kill()
                return log_msg("Process force-killed.", "WARN")
            except Exception as e:
                return log_msg(f"Error stopping process: {e}", "ERROR")
    return log_msg("No active process to stop.", "WARN")


def get_audio_info(filepath):
    """Get basic audio file info (sample rate, channels, duration)."""
    try:
        ext = pathlib.Path(filepath).suffix.lower()
        if ext == '.wav':
            with wave.open(str(filepath), 'r') as wf:
                sr = wf.getframerate()
                ch = wf.getnchannels()
                frames = wf.getnframes()
                dur = frames / sr
                return {"sample_rate": sr, "channels": ch, "duration": dur, "frames": frames}
        else:
            # For .flac and others, try librosa
            try:
                import librosa
                y, sr = librosa.load(str(filepath), sr=None, mono=False)
                if y.ndim == 1:
                    ch = 1
                else:
                    ch = y.shape[0]
                dur = len(y) if y.ndim == 1 else y.shape[1]
                dur = dur / sr
                return {"sample_rate": sr, "channels": ch, "duration": dur}
            except ImportError:
                return None
    except Exception:
        return None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TAB 1: SYSTEM INFO & SETUP (ระบบจัดสรรค์ให้อัตโนมัติ)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def detect_system_info():
    """Auto-detect all system information."""
    info_lines = []
    info_lines.append("═" * 60)
    info_lines.append("   🖥️  SYSTEM INFORMATION  (ข้อมูลระบบ)")
    info_lines.append("═" * 60)

    # OS
    info_lines.append(f"\n📌 OS: {platform.system()} {platform.release()} ({platform.machine()})")

    # CPU
    cpu_name = platform.processor() or "Unknown"
    try:
        import psutil
        cpu_count = psutil.cpu_count(logical=True)
        cpu_phys = psutil.cpu_count(logical=False)
        ram = psutil.virtual_memory()
        ram_gb = ram.total / (1024**3)
        info_lines.append(f"📌 CPU: {cpu_name}")
        info_lines.append(f"   Cores: {cpu_phys} physical / {cpu_count} logical")
        info_lines.append(f"📌 RAM: {ram_gb:.1f} GB total / {ram.available / (1024**3):.1f} GB available")
    except ImportError:
        info_lines.append(f"📌 CPU: {cpu_name}")
        info_lines.append(f"   (Install psutil for detailed info: pip install psutil)")

    # Python
    info_lines.append(f"\n📌 Python: {sys.version.split()[0]}")
    info_lines.append(f"   Executable: {get_python_executable()}")

    # PyTorch
    try:
        import torch
        info_lines.append(f"📌 PyTorch: {torch.__version__}")

        # CUDA / GPU
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            gpu_name = torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
            gpu_mem = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_mem / (1024**3)
            info_lines.append(f"✅ CUDA: {torch.version.cuda}")
            info_lines.append(f"✅ GPU: {gpu_name} ({gpu_mem:.1f} GB VRAM)")
            if torch.cuda.device_count() > 1:
                info_lines.append(f"   GPUs available: {torch.cuda.device_count()}")
        else:
            info_lines.append("⚠️ CUDA: Not available — จะใช้ CPU mode")
    except ImportError:
        info_lines.append("❌ PyTorch: Not installed!")

    # Key dependencies
    info_lines.append("\n" + "─" * 40)
    info_lines.append("📦 Dependencies Status:")
    deps = {
        'lightning': 'PyTorch Lightning',
        'librosa': 'Librosa',
        'numpy': 'NumPy',
        'yaml': 'PyYAML',
        'click': 'Click',
        'h5py': 'h5py',
        'tensorboard': 'TensorBoard',
        'onnx': 'ONNX',
        'tqdm': 'tqdm',
    }
    for module, name in deps.items():
        try:
            __import__(module)
            info_lines.append(f"   ✅ {name}")
        except ImportError:
            info_lines.append(f"   ❌ {name} — not installed")

    # Auto-determined settings
    info_lines.append("\n" + "═" * 60)
    info_lines.append("   ⚙️  AUTO-CONFIGURED SETTINGS  (ตั้งค่าอัตโนมัติ)")
    info_lines.append("═" * 60)

    settings = auto_detect_training_settings()
    for key, val in settings.items():
        info_lines.append(f"   {key}: {val}")

    # Pretrained models check
    info_lines.append("\n" + "─" * 40)
    info_lines.append("📁 Pretrained Models:")

    rmvpe_path = CHECKPOINTS_DIR / "rmvpe" / "model.pt"
    vr_path = CHECKPOINTS_DIR / "vr" / "model.pt"

    vocoder_found = False
    for d in CHECKPOINTS_DIR.iterdir() if CHECKPOINTS_DIR.exists() else []:
        if d.is_dir() and 'nsf_hifigan' in d.name.lower():
            ckpt = d / "model.ckpt"
            if ckpt.exists():
                vocoder_found = True
                info_lines.append(f"   ✅ Vocoder: {d.name}")
                break
    if not vocoder_found:
        info_lines.append("   ⚠️ Vocoder: Not found — กรุณาดาวน์โหลด NSF-HiFiGAN checkpoint")

    if rmvpe_path.exists():
        info_lines.append("   ✅ RMVPE Pitch Extractor: Found")
    else:
        info_lines.append("   ⚠️ RMVPE: Not found at checkpoints/rmvpe/model.pt")

    if vr_path.exists():
        info_lines.append("   ✅ VR Harmonic-Noise Separator: Found")
    else:
        info_lines.append("   ⚠️ VR: Not found at checkpoints/vr/model.pt")

    return "\n".join(info_lines)


def auto_detect_training_settings():
    """Auto-detect optimal training settings based on hardware."""
    settings = OrderedDict()

    try:
        import torch
        has_cuda = torch.cuda.is_available()
    except ImportError:
        has_cuda = False

    if has_cuda:
        try:
            import torch
            gpu_mem = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_mem / (1024**3)
        except Exception:
            gpu_mem = 4.0

        settings["Accelerator"] = "auto (CUDA GPU)"
        settings["Precision"] = "16-mixed"
        settings["Strategy Backend"] = "nccl"

        if gpu_mem >= 12:
            settings["Max Batch Frames"] = "50000"
            settings["Max Batch Size"] = "64"
        elif gpu_mem >= 8:
            settings["Max Batch Frames"] = "40000"
            settings["Max Batch Size"] = "48"
        elif gpu_mem >= 6:
            settings["Max Batch Frames"] = "30000"
            settings["Max Batch Size"] = "32"
        else:
            settings["Max Batch Frames"] = "20000"
            settings["Max Batch Size"] = "16"
    else:
        settings["Accelerator"] = "cpu"
        settings["Precision"] = "32 (CPU ไม่รองรับ mixed precision)"
        settings["Strategy Backend"] = "gloo"
        settings["Max Batch Frames"] = "16000"
        settings["Max Batch Size"] = "8"

    # num_workers auto
    try:
        import psutil
        cpu_count = psutil.cpu_count(logical=False) or 2
        settings["Num Workers"] = str(min(cpu_count, 4))
    except ImportError:
        settings["Num Workers"] = "2"

    settings["Pitch Extractor"] = "rmvpe (default)"
    settings["Sample Rate"] = "44100 Hz"
    settings["Mel Bins"] = "128"
    settings["Hop Size"] = "512"

    return settings


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def list_existing_projects():
    """List all existing projects in data/ directory."""
    projects = []
    if DATA_DIR.exists():
        for d in sorted(DATA_DIR.iterdir()):
            if d.is_dir() and (d / "raw").exists():
                projects.append(d.name)
    return projects


def create_project(project_name, speaker_name, speaker_id, language):
    """Create a new DiffSinger project with folder structure."""
    if not project_name or not project_name.strip():
        return log_msg("กรุณาระบุชื่อโปรเจกต์", "ERROR"), gr.update()

    project_name = project_name.strip().replace(" ", "_")
    speaker_name = speaker_name.strip() if speaker_name else project_name
    speaker_id = int(speaker_id) if speaker_id else 0

    project_dir = DATA_DIR / project_name
    raw_dir = project_dir / "raw"
    wavs_dir = raw_dir / "wavs"
    binary_dir = project_dir / "binary"
    export_dir = project_dir / "export"

    if project_dir.exists():
        return log_msg(f"โปรเจกต์ '{project_name}' มีอยู่แล้ว!", "WARN"), gr.update()

    try:
        wavs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        binary_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        export_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Create initial transcriptions.csv
        with open(raw_dir / "transcriptions.csv", 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            writer = csv.writer(f)
            writer.writerow(['name', 'ph_seq', 'ph_dur'])

        # Save project metadata
        meta = {
            "project_name": project_name,
            "speaker_name": speaker_name,
            "speaker_id": speaker_id,
            "language": language if language else "Custom-Language",
            "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "sample_rate": 44100,
        }
        with open(project_dir / "project_meta.json", 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(meta, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        msg = log_msg(f"สร้างโปรเจกต์ '{project_name}' สำเร็จ!", "OK")
        msg += f"\n   Speaker: {speaker_name} (ID: {speaker_id})"
        msg += f"\n   Language: {meta['language']}"
        msg += f"\n   Path: {project_dir}"

        projects = list_existing_projects()
        return msg, gr.update(choices=projects, value=project_name)

    except Exception as e:
        return log_msg(f"ไม่สามารถสร้างโปรเจกต์: {e}", "ERROR"), gr.update()


def upload_audio_files(project_name, files):
    """Upload audio files to project and auto-validate."""
    if not project_name:
        return log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR"), ""

    wavs_dir = DATA_DIR / project_name / "raw" / "wavs"
    if not wavs_dir.exists():
        return log_msg(f"ไม่พบโฟลเดอร์โปรเจกต์ '{project_name}'", "ERROR"), ""

    if not files:
        return log_msg("ไม่มีไฟล์ที่เลือก", "WARN"), ""

    log = []
    success_count = 0
    skip_count = 0
    error_count = 0

    log.append(log_msg(f"เริ่มอัปโหลด {len(files)} ไฟล์...", "RUN"))

    for file_path in files:
        fname = pathlib.Path(file_path).name
        ext = pathlib.Path(fname).suffix.lower()

        if ext not in ['.wav', '.flac']:
            log.append(log_msg(f"ข้าม '{fname}' — ไม่รองรับ format '{ext}'", "WARN"))
            skip_count += 1
            continue

        dest = wavs_dir / fname
        if dest.exists():
            log.append(log_msg(f"ข้าม '{fname}' — มีอยู่แล้ว", "WARN"))
            skip_count += 1
            continue

        try:
            shutil.copy2(file_path, dest)

            # Auto-validate
            info = get_audio_info(dest)
            if info:
                if info["sample_rate"] != 44100:
                    log.append(log_msg(
                        f"'{fname}' — SR={info['sample_rate']}Hz (แนะนำ 44100Hz)",
                        "WARN"
                    ))
                if info.get("channels", 1) > 1:
                    log.append(log_msg(f"'{fname}' — Stereo (จะแปลงเป็น Mono อัตโนมัติตอน Binarize)", "WARN"))

            success_count += 1
            log.append(log_msg(f"อัปโหลด '{fname}' สำเร็จ", "OK"))

        except Exception as e:
            error_count += 1
            log.append(log_msg(f"ผิดพลาด '{fname}': {e}", "ERROR"))

    log.append("")
    log.append(log_msg(
        f"สรุป: สำเร็จ {success_count}, ข้าม {skip_count}, ผิดพลาด {error_count}",
        "OK" if error_count == 0 else "WARN"
    ))

    stats = get_project_stats(project_name)
    return "\n".join(log), stats


def get_project_stats(project_name):
    """Get project statistics (auto-managed)."""
    if not project_name:
        return "ยังไม่ได้เลือกโปรเจกต์"

    wavs_dir = DATA_DIR / project_name / "raw" / "wavs"
    if not wavs_dir.exists():
        return "ไม่พบโฟลเดอร์โปรเจกต์"

    audio_files = list(wavs_dir.glob("*.wav")) + list(wavs_dir.glob("*.flac"))
    total_duration = 0.0

    for af in audio_files:
        info = get_audio_info(af)
        if info:
            total_duration += info.get("duration", 0)

    # Load metadata
    meta_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / "project_meta.json"
    meta = {}
    if meta_path.exists():
        with open(meta_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            meta = json.load(f)

    stats = f"""╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║   📊 สถิติโปรเจกต์ (Project Stats)    ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║  📁 Project: {project_name:<22} ║
║  🎤 Speaker: {meta.get('speaker_name', 'N/A'):<22} ║
║  🆔 Speaker ID: {str(meta.get('speaker_id', 0)):<19} ║
║  🌐 Language: {meta.get('language', 'N/A'):<22} ║
║  🎵 Audio Files: {str(len(audio_files)):<19} ║
║  ⏱️  Total Duration: {total_duration/60:.1f} min ({total_duration:.0f}s) ║
║  📏 Sample Rate: {str(meta.get('sample_rate', 44100)):<19} ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝"""
    return stats


def remove_duplicates(project_name):
    """Auto-remove duplicate audio files (same phonemes + same key)."""
    if not project_name:
        return log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR")

    raw_dir = DATA_DIR / project_name / "raw"
    wavs_dir = raw_dir / "wavs"
    trans_path = raw_dir / "transcriptions.csv"

    if not trans_path.exists():
        return log_msg("ไม่พบ transcriptions.csv", "WARN")

    log = [log_msg("เริ่มตรวจหาไฟล์เสียงที่ซ้ำกัน...", "RUN")]

    # Load transcriptions
    entries = []
    with open(trans_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            entries.append(row)

    if not entries:
        return log_msg("ไม่มีข้อมูล transcription สำหรับตรวจสอบ", "WARN")

    # Detect duplicates by ph_seq content
    seen = {}
    duplicates = []
    for entry in entries:
        key = entry.get('ph_seq', '').strip()
        if key in seen:
            duplicates.append(entry)
            log.append(log_msg(
                f"พบซ้ำ: '{entry['name']}' มี ph_seq เหมือนกับ '{seen[key]['name']}'",
                "WARN"
            ))
        else:
            seen[key] = entry

    if not duplicates:
        log.append(log_msg("ไม่พบไฟล์เสียงที่ซ้ำกัน ✨", "OK"))
        return "\n".join(log)

    # Remove duplicate entries
    dup_names = {d['name'] for d in duplicates}
    kept = [e for e in entries if e['name'] not in dup_names]

    # Rewrite transcriptions.csv
    with open(trans_path, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['name', 'ph_seq', 'ph_dur'])
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(kept)

    # Remove audio files
    removed_count = 0
    for dn in dup_names:
        for ext in ['.wav', '.flac']:
            dup_file = wavs_dir / f"{dn}{ext}"
            if dup_file.exists():
                dup_file.unlink()
                removed_count += 1
                log.append(log_msg(f"ลบไฟล์: {dn}{ext}", "OK"))

    log.append("")
    log.append(log_msg(f"สรุป: ลบไฟล์ซ้ำ {removed_count} ไฟล์, เหลือ {len(kept)} รายการ", "OK"))
    return "\n".join(log)


def scan_phonemes_from_data(project_name):
    """Scan all phonemes used in the dataset to build Custom-Language dictionary."""
    if not project_name:
        return log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR"), ""

    trans_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / "raw" / "transcriptions.csv"
    if not trans_path.exists():
        return log_msg("ไม่พบ transcriptions.csv", "WARN"), ""

    phonemes = set()
    with open(trans_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            ph_seq = row.get('ph_seq', '')
            for ph in ph_seq.strip().split():
                if '/' in ph:
                    ph = ph.split('/', maxsplit=1)[1]
                phonemes.add(ph)

    # Always include special phonemes
    phonemes.add('AP')
    phonemes.add('SP')

    sorted_ph = sorted(phonemes)

    log = log_msg(f"พบ {len(sorted_ph)} หน่วยเสียง (phonemes) ในชุดข้อมูล", "OK")
    dict_content = "\n".join(f"{ph}\t{ph}" for ph in sorted_ph)

    return log, dict_content


def save_custom_dictionary(project_name, dict_content):
    """Save custom dictionary for the project."""
    if not project_name or not dict_content:
        return log_msg("ข้อมูลไม่ครบ", "ERROR")

    dict_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / "custom_dictionary.txt"
    try:
        with open(dict_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(dict_content)
        return log_msg(f"บันทึก dictionary ไปยัง {dict_path}", "OK")
    except Exception as e:
        return log_msg(f"ผิดพลาด: {e}", "ERROR")


def load_transcriptions(project_name):
    """Load transcription data as editable text."""
    if not project_name:
        return ""
    trans_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / "raw" / "transcriptions.csv"
    if not trans_path.exists():
        return "name,ph_seq,ph_dur\n"
    with open(trans_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return f.read()


def save_transcriptions(project_name, csv_text):
    """Save edited transcription data."""
    if not project_name:
        return log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR")
    trans_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / "raw" / "transcriptions.csv"
    try:
        with open(trans_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
            f.write(csv_text)
        # Count entries
        lines = [l for l in csv_text.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
        count = max(0, len(lines) - 1)
        return log_msg(f"บันทึก transcription สำเร็จ ({count} รายการ)", "OK")
    except Exception as e:
        return log_msg(f"ผิดพลาด: {e}", "ERROR")

def get_vocoder_ckpt_path():
    """Find vocoder checkpoint path."""
    if CHECKPOINTS_DIR.exists():
        for d in CHECKPOINTS_DIR.iterdir():
            if d.is_dir() and 'nsf_hifigan' in d.name.lower():
                ckpt = d / "model.ckpt"
                if ckpt.exists():
                    return f"checkpoints/{d.name}/model.ckpt"
    return "checkpoints/nsf_hifigan/model.ckpt"


def generate_config(project_name, model_type, max_updates, finetune_enabled,
                    finetune_ckpt_path):
    """Auto-generate config YAML based on system + data analysis."""
    if not project_name:
        return log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR"), ""

    project_dir = DATA_DIR / project_name
    meta_path = project_dir / "project_meta.json"

    if not meta_path.exists():
        return log_msg("ไม่พบข้อมูลโปรเจกต์", "ERROR"), ""

    with open(meta_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        meta = json.load(f)

    # Auto-detect settings
    settings = auto_detect_training_settings()
    has_cuda = "CUDA" in settings.get("Accelerator", "")
    max_updates = int(max_updates) if max_updates else 160000
    num_workers = int(settings.get("Num Workers", "2"))

    # Language & dictionary
    language = meta.get("language", "Custom-Language")
    speaker_name = meta.get("speaker_name", project_name)
    speaker_id = meta.get("speaker_id", 0)

    # Dictionary path
    if language == "Custom-Language":
        dict_path = f"data/{project_name}/custom_dictionary.txt"
    elif language == "zh":
        dict_path = "dictionaries/opencpop-extension.txt"
    else:
        dict_path = f"data/{project_name}/custom_dictionary.txt"

    # Determine test prefixes (use first 5 items or 10% of data)
    wavs_dir = project_dir / "raw" / "wavs"
    audio_files = sorted([f.stem for f in wavs_dir.glob("*.wav")] +
                         [f.stem for f in wavs_dir.glob("*.flac")])
    num_test = max(1, min(5, len(audio_files) // 10))
    test_prefixes = audio_files[:num_test] if audio_files else ["test"]

    if model_type == "Acoustic":
        config = _generate_acoustic_config(
            project_name, speaker_name, speaker_id, language, dict_path,
            test_prefixes, max_updates, num_workers, has_cuda, settings,
            finetune_enabled, finetune_ckpt_path
        )
        filename = "config_acoustic.yaml"
    else:
        config = _generate_variance_config(
            project_name, speaker_name, speaker_id, language, dict_path,
            test_prefixes, max_updates, num_workers, has_cuda, settings,
            finetune_enabled, finetune_ckpt_path
        )
        filename = "config_variance.yaml"

    yaml_text = safe_yaml_dump(config)
    log = log_msg(f"Auto-generated {filename} สำหรับ '{project_name}'", "OK")
    log += f"\n   Model Type: {model_type}"
    log += f"\n   Max Updates: {max_updates:,}"
    log += f"\n   Device: {settings.get('Accelerator', 'auto')}"
    log += f"\n   Precision: {settings.get('Precision', 'auto')}"
    log += f"\n   Language: {language}"

    return log, yaml_text


def _generate_acoustic_config(project_name, speaker_name, speaker_id, language,
                               dict_path, test_prefixes, max_updates, num_workers,
                               has_cuda, settings, finetune_enabled, finetune_ckpt_path):
    """Generate acoustic model config."""
    vocoder_ckpt = get_vocoder_ckpt_path()

    config = OrderedDict()
    config['base_config'] = ['configs/acoustic.yaml']

    # Dictionary
    config['dictionaries'] = {language: dict_path}
    config['extra_phonemes'] = []
    config['merged_phoneme_groups'] = []

    # Dataset
    config['datasets'] = [{
        'raw_data_dir': f'data/{project_name}/raw',
        'speaker': speaker_name,
        'spk_id': speaker_id,
        'language': language,
        'test_prefixes': test_prefixes,
    }]

    config['binary_data_dir'] = f'data/{project_name}/binary'
    config['binarization_args'] = {'num_workers': num_workers, 'shuffle': True}

    # Pitch extractor — RMVPE default
    config['pe'] = 'rmvpe'
    config['pe_ckpt'] = 'checkpoints/rmvpe/model.pt'
    config['hnsep'] = 'vr'
    config['hnsep_ckpt'] = 'checkpoints/vr/model.pt'

    # Vocoder
    config['vocoder'] = 'NsfHifiGAN'
    config['vocoder_ckpt'] = vocoder_ckpt

    # Speaker/Language
    config['use_lang_id'] = False
    config['num_lang'] = 1
    config['use_spk_id'] = False
    config['num_spk'] = 1

    # Variance embeddings (auto)
    config['use_energy_embed'] = False
    config['use_breathiness_embed'] = False
    config['use_voicing_embed'] = False
    config['use_tension_embed'] = False
    config['use_key_shift_embed'] = True
    config['use_speed_embed'] = True

    # Augmentation (auto - enabled for quality)
    config['augmentation_args'] = {
        'random_pitch_shifting': {
            'enabled': True,
            'range': [-5.0, 5.0],
            'scale': 0.75,
        },
        'fixed_pitch_shifting': {
            'enabled': False,
            'targets': [-5.0, 5.0],
            'scale': 0.5,
        },
        'random_time_stretching': {
            'enabled': True,
            'range': [0.5, 2.0],
            'scale': 0.75,
        },
    }

    # Diffusion (auto — best quality)
    config['diffusion_type'] = 'reflow'
    config['enc_ffn_kernel_size'] = 3
    config['use_rope'] = True
    config['use_shallow_diffusion'] = True
    config['T_start'] = 0.4
    config['T_start_infer'] = 0.4
    config['K_step'] = 300
    config['K_step_infer'] = 300

    config['backbone_type'] = 'lynxnet'
    config['backbone_args'] = {
        'num_channels': 1024,
        'num_layers': 6,
        'kernel_size': 31,
        'dropout_rate': 0.0,
        'strong_cond': True,
    }

    config['shallow_diffusion_args'] = {
        'train_aux_decoder': True,
        'train_diffusion': True,
        'val_gt_start': False,
        'aux_decoder_arch': 'convnext',
        'aux_decoder_args': {
            'num_channels': 512,
            'num_layers': 6,
            'kernel_size': 7,
            'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        },
        'aux_decoder_grad': 0.1,
    }
    config['lambda_aux_mel_loss'] = 0.2

    # Training (auto-managed based on hardware)
    config['optimizer_args'] = {'lr': 0.0006}
    config['lr_scheduler_args'] = {
        'scheduler_cls': 'torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR',
        'step_size': 10000,
        'gamma': 0.75,
    }

    max_batch_frames = int(settings.get("Max Batch Frames", "50000"))
    max_batch_size = int(settings.get("Max Batch Size", "64"))
    config['max_batch_frames'] = max_batch_frames
    config['max_batch_size'] = max_batch_size
    config['max_updates'] = max_updates

    config['num_valid_plots'] = 10
    config['val_with_vocoder'] = True
    config['val_check_interval'] = 2000
    config['num_ckpt_keep'] = 5
    config['permanent_ckpt_start'] = max(max_updates // 2, 10000)
    config['permanent_ckpt_interval'] = max(max_updates // 8, 5000)

    # Hardware (auto)
    config['pl_trainer_devices'] = 'auto'
    if has_cuda:
        config['pl_trainer_precision'] = '16-mixed'
    else:
        config['pl_trainer_accelerator'] = 'cpu'
        config['pl_trainer_precision'] = '32'
        config['pl_trainer_strategy'] = {
            'name': 'auto',
            'process_group_backend': 'gloo',
            'find_unused_parameters': False,
        }

    # Finetune
    config['finetune_enabled'] = bool(finetune_enabled)
    config['finetune_ckpt_path'] = finetune_ckpt_path if finetune_enabled else None
    config['finetune_ignored_params'] = [
        'model.fs2.encoder.embed_tokens',
        'model.fs2.txt_embed',
        'model.fs2.spk_embed',
    ]
    config['finetune_strict_shapes'] = True
    config['freezing_enabled'] = False
    config['frozen_params'] = []

    return config


def _generate_variance_config(project_name, speaker_name, speaker_id, language,
                               dict_path, test_prefixes, max_updates, num_workers,
                               has_cuda, settings, finetune_enabled, finetune_ckpt_path):
    """Generate variance model config."""
    config = OrderedDict()
    config['base_config'] = ['configs/variance.yaml']

    config['dictionaries'] = {language: dict_path}
    config['extra_phonemes'] = []
    config['merged_phoneme_groups'] = []

    config['datasets'] = [{
        'raw_data_dir': f'data/{project_name}/raw',
        'speaker': speaker_name,
        'spk_id': speaker_id,
        'language': language,
        'test_prefixes': test_prefixes,
    }]

    config['binary_data_dir'] = f'data/{project_name}/binary'
    config['binarization_args'] = {'num_workers': num_workers, 'shuffle': True}

    # Pitch extractor
    config['pe'] = 'rmvpe'
    config['pe_ckpt'] = 'checkpoints/rmvpe/model.pt'
    config['hnsep'] = 'vr'
    config['hnsep_ckpt'] = 'checkpoints/vr/model.pt'

    # Speaker/Language
    config['use_lang_id'] = False
    config['num_lang'] = 1
    config['use_spk_id'] = False
    config['num_spk'] = 1

    # Predictions (auto — all useful for quality singing)
    config['predict_dur'] = True
    config['predict_pitch'] = True
    config['predict_energy'] = False
    config['predict_breathiness'] = False
    config['predict_voicing'] = False
    config['predict_tension'] = False

    # Architecture (auto)
    config['enc_ffn_kernel_size'] = 3
    config['use_rope'] = True
    config['hidden_size'] = 256

    config['dur_prediction_args'] = {
        'arch': 'fs2',
        'hidden_size': 512,
        'dropout': 0.1,
        'num_layers': 5,
        'kernel_size': 3,
        'log_offset': 1.0,
        'loss_type': 'mse',
        'lambda_pdur_loss': 0.3,
        'lambda_wdur_loss': 1.0,
        'lambda_sdur_loss': 3.0,
    }

    config['use_melody_encoder'] = False
    config['use_glide_embed'] = False

    config['diffusion_type'] = 'reflow'

    config['pitch_prediction_args'] = {
        'pitd_norm_min': -8.0,
        'pitd_norm_max': 8.0,
        'pitd_clip_min': -12.0,
        'pitd_clip_max': 12.0,
        'repeat_bins': 64,
        'backbone_type': 'wavenet',
        'backbone_args': {
            'num_layers': 20,
            'num_channels': 256,
            'dilation_cycle_length': 5,
        },
    }

    config['variances_prediction_args'] = {
        'total_repeat_bins': 48,
        'backbone_type': 'wavenet',
        'backbone_args': {
            'num_layers': 10,
            'num_channels': 192,
            'dilation_cycle_length': 4,
        },
    }

    config['lambda_dur_loss'] = 1.0
    config['lambda_pitch_loss'] = 1.0
    config['lambda_var_loss'] = 1.0

    # Training (auto)
    config['optimizer_args'] = {'lr': 0.0006}
    config['lr_scheduler_args'] = {
        'scheduler_cls': 'torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR',
        'step_size': 10000,
        'gamma': 0.75,
    }

    max_batch_frames = int(settings.get("Max Batch Frames", "50000"))
    config['max_batch_frames'] = min(80000, max_batch_frames + 30000)
    config['max_batch_size'] = 48
    config['max_updates'] = max_updates

    config['num_valid_plots'] = 10
    config['val_check_interval'] = 2000
    config['num_ckpt_keep'] = 5
    config['permanent_ckpt_start'] = max(max_updates // 2, 10000)
    config['permanent_ckpt_interval'] = max(max_updates // 8, 5000)

    # Hardware
    config['pl_trainer_devices'] = 'auto'
    if has_cuda:
        config['pl_trainer_precision'] = '16-mixed'
    else:
        config['pl_trainer_accelerator'] = 'cpu'
        config['pl_trainer_precision'] = '32'
        config['pl_trainer_strategy'] = {
            'name': 'auto',
            'process_group_backend': 'gloo',
            'find_unused_parameters': False,
        }

    # Finetune
    config['finetune_enabled'] = bool(finetune_enabled)
    config['finetune_ckpt_path'] = finetune_ckpt_path if finetune_enabled else None
    config['finetune_ignored_params'] = [
        'model.spk_embed',
        'model.fs2.txt_embed',
        'model.fs2.encoder.embed_tokens',
    ]
    config['finetune_strict_shapes'] = True
    config['freezing_enabled'] = False
    config['frozen_params'] = []

    return config


def save_config(project_name, model_type, yaml_text):
    """Save config YAML to project directory."""
    if not project_name or not yaml_text:
        return log_msg("ข้อมูลไม่ครบ", "ERROR")

    filename = "config_acoustic.yaml" if model_type == "Acoustic" else "config_variance.yaml"
    config_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / filename

    try:
        with open(config_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(yaml_text)
        return log_msg(f"บันทึก {filename} สำเร็จ → {config_path}", "OK")
    except Exception as e:
        return log_msg(f"ผิดพลาด: {e}", "ERROR")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TAB 4: PREPROCESSING / BINARIZATION (ระบบจัดสรรค์ให้)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def run_binarize(project_name, model_type):
    """Run binarization process with real-time log streaming."""
    if not project_name:
        yield log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR")
        return

    filename = "config_acoustic.yaml" if model_type == "Acoustic" else "config_variance.yaml"
    config_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / filename

    if not config_path.exists():
        yield log_msg(f"ไม่พบ config file: {config_path}\nกรุณาสร้าง config ก่อนที่ Tab 3", "ERROR")
        return

    python = get_python_executable()
    cmd = [python, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "binarize.py"), "--config", str(config_path)]

    yield log_msg(f"เริ่ม Binarization สำหรับ '{project_name}' ({model_type})...", "RUN")
    yield log_msg(f"Command: {' '.join(cmd)}", "INFO") + "\n"

    for output in run_subprocess_streaming(cmd):
        yield output


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TAB 5: TRAINING (ระบบจัดสรรค์ + ผู้ใช้ควบคุม)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def run_training(project_name, model_type, exp_name, resume):
    """Run training process with real-time log streaming."""
    if not project_name:
        yield log_msg("กรุณาเลือกโปรเจกต์ก่อน", "ERROR")
        return

    if not exp_name or not exp_name.strip():
        exp_name = f"{project_name}_{model_type.lower()}"

    filename = "config_acoustic.yaml" if model_type == "Acoustic" else "config_variance.yaml"
    config_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / filename

    if not config_path.exists():
        yield log_msg(f"ไม่พบ config file: {config_path}", "ERROR")
        return

    python = get_python_executable()
    cmd = [
        python, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "train.py"),
        "--config", str(config_path),
        "--exp_name", exp_name.strip(),
    ]

    if not resume:
        cmd.append("--reset")

    mode = "Resume Training" if resume else "New Training"
    yield log_msg(f"เริ่ม {mode}: '{exp_name}' ({model_type})", "RUN")
    yield log_msg(f"Config: {config_path}", "INFO")
    yield log_msg(f"Checkpoints: checkpoints/{exp_name}/", "INFO") + "\n"

    for output in run_subprocess_streaming(cmd):
        yield output


def stop_training():
    """Stop the current training process."""
    return stop_active_process()


def list_checkpoints(exp_name):
    """List available checkpoints for an experiment."""
    if not exp_name or not exp_name.strip():
        return "ยังไม่ได้ระบุชื่อ Experiment"

    ckpt_dir = CHECKPOINTS_DIR / exp_name.strip()
    if not ckpt_dir.exists():
        return f"ไม่พบ checkpoints สำหรับ '{exp_name}'"

    lines = [f"📁 Checkpoints for '{exp_name}':", ""]

    ckpt_files = sorted(ckpt_dir.glob("model_ckpt_steps_*.ckpt"), reverse=True)
    config_exists = (ckpt_dir / "config.yaml").exists()

    if config_exists:
        lines.append("   ✅ config.yaml — saved")

    if not ckpt_files:
        lines.append("   (ยังไม่มี checkpoint)")
    else:
        for ckpt in ckpt_files:
            size_mb = ckpt.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
            step = ckpt.stem.replace("model_ckpt_steps_", "")
            mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(ckpt.stat().st_mtime).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
            lines.append(f"   📌 Step {step:>8}  |  {size_mb:>7.1f} MB  |  {mtime}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def list_all_experiments():
    """List all experiments in checkpoints directory."""
    exps = []
    if CHECKPOINTS_DIR.exists():
        for d in sorted(CHECKPOINTS_DIR.iterdir()):
            if d.is_dir() and d.name not in ['.gitkeep']:
                config = d / "config.yaml"
                ckpts = list(d.glob("model_ckpt_steps_*.ckpt"))
                if config.exists() or ckpts:
                    exps.append(d.name)
    return exps


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TAB 6: EXPORT & PACKAGE FOR OPENUTAU
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def get_checkpoint_steps(exp_name):
    """Get available checkpoint steps for an experiment."""
    if not exp_name:
        return []
    ckpt_dir = CHECKPOINTS_DIR / exp_name
    if not ckpt_dir.exists():
        return []
    steps = []
    for ckpt in sorted(ckpt_dir.glob("model_ckpt_steps_*.ckpt"), reverse=True):
        step = ckpt.stem.replace("model_ckpt_steps_", "")
        steps.append(step)
    return steps


def run_export(project_name, exp_name, export_type, ckpt_step):
    """Run ONNX export process."""
    if not exp_name:
        yield log_msg("กรุณาระบุชื่อ Experiment", "ERROR")
        return

    python = get_python_executable()
    out_dir = str(DATA_DIR / project_name / "export") if project_name else None

    if export_type == "Acoustic":
        cmd = [python, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "export.py"), "acoustic", "--exp", exp_name]
    elif export_type == "Variance":
        cmd = [python, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "export.py"), "variance", "--exp", exp_name]
    elif export_type == "Vocoder (NSF-HiFiGAN)":
        vocoder_ckpt = get_vocoder_ckpt_path()
        config_path = str(CONFIGS_DIR / "acoustic.yaml")
        cmd = [python, str(SCRIPTS_DIR / "export.py"), "nsf-hifigan",
               "--config", config_path, "--ckpt", str(ROOT_DIR / vocoder_ckpt)]
    else:
        yield log_msg(f"Unknown export type: {export_type}", "ERROR")
        return

    if ckpt_step and export_type != "Vocoder (NSF-HiFiGAN)":
        cmd.extend(["--ckpt", str(ckpt_step)])

    if out_dir:
        cmd.extend(["--out", out_dir])

    yield log_msg(f"เริ่ม Export {export_type} → ONNX", "RUN")
    yield log_msg(f"Experiment: {exp_name}", "INFO")
    if ckpt_step:
        yield log_msg(f"Checkpoint Step: {ckpt_step}", "INFO")

    # Check PyTorch version
    try:
        import torch
        if not torch.__version__.startswith('1.13.'):
            yield log_msg(
                f"⚠️ คำเตือน: ONNX Export ต้องการ PyTorch 1.13.x (ปัจจุบัน: {torch.__version__})\n"
                "   กรุณาสร้าง virtual environment แยกสำหรับ export\n"
                "   ดูรายละเอียดที่ docs/GettingStarted.md",
                "WARN"
            )
    except ImportError:
        pass

    yield "\n"

    for output in run_subprocess_streaming(cmd):
        yield output


def package_for_openutau(project_name, exp_name, voicebank_name, author,
                          description, version, web_link):
    """Package exported files into OpenUtau-compatible voice bank."""
    if not project_name or not exp_name:
        return log_msg("กรุณาระบุโปรเจกต์และ Experiment", "ERROR")

    export_dir = DATA_DIR / project_name / "export"
    if not export_dir.exists():
        export_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    log_lines = [log_msg("เริ่มสร้างชุดคลังเสียง OpenUtau...", "RUN")]

    # Load project metadata
    meta_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / "project_meta.json"
    meta = {}
    if meta_path.exists():
        with open(meta_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            meta = json.load(f)

    voicebank_name = voicebank_name or project_name
    author = author or "DiffSinger Trainer UI"
    version = version or "1.0.0"

    # Create character.yaml for OpenUtau
    character = OrderedDict()
    character['name'] = voicebank_name
    character['singer'] = meta.get('speaker_name', project_name)
    character['author'] = author
    character['version'] = version
    character['description'] = description or f"DiffSinger voice bank: {voicebank_name}"
    character['web'] = web_link or ''
    character['singer_type'] = 'diffsinger'
    character['language'] = meta.get('language', 'Custom-Language')
    character['image'] = 'avatar.png'

    # Write character.yaml
    char_path = export_dir / "character.yaml"
    with open(char_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        yaml.dump(dict(character), f, allow_unicode=True, default_flow_style=False)
    log_lines.append(log_msg("สร้าง character.yaml สำเร็จ", "OK"))

    # Copy dictionary
    dict_src = None
    language = meta.get('language', 'Custom-Language')
    if language == "Custom-Language":
        dict_src = DATA_DIR / project_name / "custom_dictionary.txt"
    elif language == "zh":
        dict_src = DICTIONARIES_DIR / "opencpop-extension.txt"

    if dict_src and dict_src.exists():
        shutil.copy2(dict_src, export_dir / "dsdict.txt")
        log_lines.append(log_msg("คัดลอก dictionary → dsdict.txt", "OK"))

    # Copy dsconfig.yaml if exists in artifacts
    artifacts_dir = ROOT_DIR / "artifacts" / exp_name
    if artifacts_dir.exists():
        for f in artifacts_dir.iterdir():
            if f.suffix in ['.onnx', '.yaml', '.json', '.txt', '.emb']:
                dest = export_dir / f.name
                if not dest.exists() or f.stat().st_mtime > dest.stat().st_mtime:
                    shutil.copy2(f, dest)
                    log_lines.append(log_msg(f"คัดลอก {f.name}", "OK"))

    # Check for ONNX files
    onnx_files = list(export_dir.glob("*.onnx"))
    if onnx_files:
        log_lines.append(log_msg(f"พบ ONNX models: {len(onnx_files)} ไฟล์", "OK"))
        for of in onnx_files:
            size_mb = of.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
            log_lines.append(f"   📦 {of.name} ({size_mb:.1f} MB)")
    else:
        log_lines.append(log_msg(
            "ยังไม่มี ONNX models — กรุณา Export ONNX ก่อน",
            "WARN"
        ))

    # Create zip package
    try:
        zip_name = f"{voicebank_name.replace(' ', '_')}_OpenUtau"
        zip_path = DATA_DIR / project_name / zip_name

        shutil.make_archive(str(zip_path), 'zip', str(export_dir))
        final_zip = pathlib.Path(str(zip_path) + '.zip')
        zip_size = final_zip.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)

        log_lines.append("")
        log_lines.append(log_msg(f"📦 สร้าง Package สำเร็จ!", "OK"))
        log_lines.append(f"   ไฟล์: {final_zip}")
        log_lines.append(f"   ขนาด: {zip_size:.1f} MB")
        log_lines.append("")
        log_lines.append("   ✨ พร้อมใช้งานใน OpenUtau!")
        log_lines.append("   วิธีใช้: คัดลอกโฟลเดอร์ export/ ไปยังโฟลเดอร์ Singers ของ OpenUtau")
        log_lines.append("   หรือแตกไฟล์ .zip ไปยังโฟลเดอร์ Singers")

    except Exception as e:
        log_lines.append(log_msg(f"ไม่สามารถสร้าง zip: {e}", "ERROR"))

    return "\n".join(log_lines)

import argparse
import os
import yaml
import subprocess
import sys

def print_banner(msg):
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f" {msg} ")
    print("=" * 60)

def validate_config(config_path):
    print_banner("1. CONFIG VALIDATION")
    if not os.path.exists(config_path):
        print(f"[ERROR] ไม่พบไฟล์ Config ที่ระบุ: {config_path}")
        return False
    
    try:
        with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            config = yaml.safe_load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERROR] ไม่สามารถอ่านไฟล์ Config ({config_path}) ได้: {e}")
        return False
        
    binary_data_dir = config.get('binary_data_dir', '')
    if binary_data_dir and not os.path.exists(binary_data_dir):
        print(f"[ERROR] ไม่พบโฟลเดอร์ binary_data_dir ที่ระบุใน config: {binary_data_dir}")
        print("          (โปรดตรวจสอบว่ารันขั้นตอน Binarize หรือยัง หรือระบุพาธผิด)")
        return False
        
    max_batch_size = config.get('max_batch_size', 0)
    if max_batch_size > 24:
        print(f"[WARNING] max_batch_size ใน config มีค่า {max_batch_size} ซึ่งอาจทำให้เกิด GPU OOM ได้")
        print("          แนะนำให้ปรับลดลงเหลือประมาณ 12-16 หาก VRAM ไม่พอ")
        
    print("[OK] ตรวจสอบไฟล์ Config เบื้องต้นผ่านแล้ว!")
    return True

def run_training(config_path, exp_name):
    print_banner("2. TRAINING")
    cmd = [sys.executable, "scripts/train.py", "--config", config_path, "--exp_name", exp_name]
    print(f"กำลังรันคำสั่ง: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
        print("[SUCCESS] การเทรนเสร็จสมบูรณ์!")
        return True
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"\n[ERROR] เกิดข้อผิดพลาดขณะเทรน (Exit Code: {e.returncode})")
        print("สรุปปัญหาที่อาจเป็นไปได้:")
        print("1. GPU Out of Memory (OOM) - แนะนำให้เปิดไฟล์ config ไปลด max_batch_size หรือ max_batch_frames")
        print("2. ข้อมูลสูญหายหรือพาธไม่ถูกต้อง - ตรวจสอบ binary_data_dir")
        print("3. โค้ดหรือ Python Environment มีปัญหา")
        return False

def run_export(exp_name, out_dir):
    print_banner("3. ONNX EXPORT")
    cmd = [sys.executable, "scripts/export.py", "--exp_name", exp_name]
    if out_dir:
        cmd.extend(["--out", out_dir])
        
    print(f"กำลังรันคำสั่ง: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
        print("[SUCCESS] การ Export เป็น ONNX เสร็จสมบูรณ์!")
        
        # Determine final output dir
        if not out_dir:
            out_dir = os.path.join("checkpoints", exp_name)
            
        print_banner("SUMMARY & OUTPUT")
        print(f"✅ สำเร็จ! ไฟล์ ONNX และโมเดลสำหรับ OpenUtau ถูกจัดเก็บไว้ที่:")
        print(f"   >> {os.path.abspath(out_dir)} <<")
        print("สามารถนำโฟลเดอร์นี้ไปใช้งานใน OpenUtau หรือโปรแกรมที่รองรับได้ทันที")
        
        return True
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"\n[ERROR] เกิดข้อผิดพลาดขณะส่งออกโมเดล (Export ONNX) (Exit Code: {e.returncode})")
        print("สรุปปัญหาที่อาจเป็นไปได้:")
        print("1. ไม่พบ Checkpoint (โมเดลอาจจะเทรนไม่เสร็จ หรือระบุ exp_name ผิด)")
        print("2. ไลบรารีสำหรับ ONNX ไม่ครบ (รัน pip install -r requirements-onnx.txt)")
        return False

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DiffSinger 1-Click Pipeline (Train + Export)")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=str, default="configs/variance.yaml", help="Path to config file")
    parser.add_argument("--exp_name", type=str, required=True, help="Experiment name (e.g., my_model)")
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=str, default="", help="Output directory for ONNX (optional)")
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if not validate_config(args.config):
        sys.exit(1)
        
    if not run_training(args.config, args.exp_name):
        sys.exit(1)
        
    if not run_export(args.exp_name, args.out):
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Python shell for SymPy.

This is just a normal Python shell (IPython shell if you have the
IPython package installed), that executes the following commands for
the user:

    >>> from __future__ import division
    >>> from sympy import *
    >>> x, y, z, t = symbols('x y z t')
    >>> k, m, n = symbols('k m n', integer=True)
    >>> f, g, h = symbols('f g h', cls=Function)
    >>> init_printing()

So starting 'isympy' is equivalent to starting Python (or IPython) and
executing the above commands by hand.  It is intended for easy and quick
experimentation with SymPy.  isympy is a good way to use SymPy as an
interactive calculator. If you have IPython and Matplotlib installed, then
interactive plotting is enabled by default.

COMMAND LINE OPTIONS
--------------------

-c CONSOLE, --console=CONSOLE

     Use the specified shell (Python or IPython) shell as the console
     backend instead of the default one (IPython if present, Python
     otherwise), e.g.:

        $isympy -c python

    CONSOLE must be one of 'ipython' or 'python'

-p PRETTY, --pretty PRETTY

    Setup pretty-printing in SymPy. When pretty-printing is enabled,
    expressions can be printed with Unicode or ASCII. The default is
    to use pretty-printing (with Unicode if the terminal supports it).
    When this option is 'no', expressions will not be pretty-printed
    and ASCII will be used:

        $isympy -p no

    PRETTY must be one of 'unicode', 'ascii', or 'no'

-t TYPES, --types=TYPES

    Setup the ground types for the polys.  By default, gmpy ground types
    are used if gmpy2 or gmpy is installed, otherwise it falls back to python
    ground types, which are a little bit slower.  You can manually
    choose python ground types even if gmpy is installed (e.g., for
    testing purposes):

        $isympy -t python

    TYPES must be one of 'gmpy', 'gmpy1' or 'python'

    Note that the ground type gmpy1 is primarily intended for testing; it
    forces the use of gmpy version 1 even if gmpy2 is available.

    This is the same as setting the environment variable
    SYMPY_GROUND_TYPES to the given ground type (e.g.,
    SYMPY_GROUND_TYPES='gmpy')

    The ground types can be determined interactively from the variable
    sympy.polys.domains.GROUND_TYPES.

-o ORDER, --order ORDER

    Setup the ordering of terms for printing.  The default is lex, which
    orders terms lexicographically (e.g., x**2 + x + 1). You can choose
    other orderings, such as rev-lex, which will use reverse
    lexicographic ordering (e.g., 1 + x + x**2):

        $isympy -o rev-lex

    ORDER must be one of 'lex', 'rev-lex', 'grlex', 'rev-grlex',
    'grevlex', 'rev-grevlex', 'old', or 'none'.

    Note that for very large expressions, ORDER='none' may speed up
    printing considerably but the terms will have no canonical order.

-q, --quiet

    Print only Python's and SymPy's versions to stdout at startup.

-d, --doctest

    Use the same format that should be used for doctests.  This is
    equivalent to -c python -p no.

-C, --no-cache

    Disable the caching mechanism.  Disabling the cache may slow certain
    operations down considerably.  This is useful for testing the cache,
    or for benchmarking, as the cache can result in deceptive timings.

    This is equivalent to setting the environment variable
    SYMPY_USE_CACHE to 'no'.

-a, --auto-symbols (requires at least IPython 0.11)

    Automatically create missing symbols.  Normally, typing a name of a
    Symbol that has not been instantiated first would raise NameError,
    but with this option enabled, any undefined name will be
    automatically created as a Symbol.

    Note that this is intended only for interactive, calculator style
    usage. In a script that uses SymPy, Symbols should be instantiated
    at the top, so that it's clear what they are.

    This will not override any names that are already defined, which
    includes the single character letters represented by the mnemonic

import os
import sys

# DO NOT IMPORT SYMPY HERE! Or the setting of the sympy environment variables
# by the command line will break.

def main() -> None:
    from argparse import ArgumentParser, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter

    VERSION = None
    if '--version' in sys.argv:
        # We cannot import sympy before this is run, because flags like -C and
        # -t set environment variables that must be set before SymPy is
        # imported. The only thing we need to import it for is to get the
        # version, which only matters with the --version flag.
        import sympy
        VERSION = sympy.__version__

    usage = 'isympy [options] -- [ipython options]'
    parser = ArgumentParser(
        usage=usage,
        description=__doc__,
        formatter_class=RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
    )

    parser.add_argument('--version', action='version', version=VERSION)

    parser.add_argument(
        '-c', '--console',
        dest='console',
        action='store',
        default=None,
        choices=['ipython', 'python'],
        metavar='CONSOLE',
        help='select type of interactive session: ipython | python; defaults '
        'to ipython if IPython is installed, otherwise python')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-p', '--pretty',
        dest='pretty',
        action='store',
        default=None,
        metavar='PRETTY',
        choices=['unicode', 'ascii', 'no'],
        help='setup pretty printing: unicode | ascii | no; defaults to '
        'unicode printing if the terminal supports it, otherwise ascii')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-t', '--types',
        dest='types',
        action='store',
        default=None,
        metavar='TYPES',
        choices=['gmpy', 'gmpy1', 'python'],
        help='setup ground types: gmpy | gmpy1 | python; defaults to gmpy if gmpy2 '
        'or gmpy is installed, otherwise python')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-o', '--order',
        dest='order',
        action='store',
        default=None,
        metavar='ORDER',
        choices=['lex', 'grlex', 'grevlex', 'rev-lex', 'rev-grlex', 'rev-grevlex', 'old', 'none'],
        help='setup ordering of terms: [rev-]lex | [rev-]grlex | [rev-]grevlex | old | none; defaults to lex')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-q', '--quiet',
        dest='quiet',
        action='store_true',
        default=False,
        help='print only version information at startup')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-d', '--doctest',
        dest='doctest',
        action='store_true',
        default=False,
        help='use the doctest format for output (you can just copy and paste it)')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-C', '--no-cache',
        dest='cache',
        action='store_false',
        default=True,
        help='disable caching mechanism')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-a', '--auto-symbols',
        dest='auto_symbols',
        action='store_true',
        default=False,
        help='automatically construct missing symbols')

    parser.add_argument(
        '-i', '--int-to-Integer',
        dest='auto_int_to_Integer',
        action='store_true',
        default=False,
        help="automatically wrap int literals with Integer")

    parser.add_argument(
        '-I', '--interactive',
        dest='interactive',
        action='store_true',
        default=False,
        help="equivalent to -a -i")

    parser.add_argument(
        '-D', '--debug',
        dest='debug',
        action='store_true',
        default=False,
        help='enable debugging output')

    (options, ipy_args) = parser.parse_known_args()
    if '--' in ipy_args:
        ipy_args.remove('--')

    if not options.cache:
        os.environ['SYMPY_USE_CACHE'] = 'no'

    if options.types:
        os.environ['SYMPY_GROUND_TYPES'] = options.types

    if options.debug:
        os.environ['SYMPY_DEBUG'] = str(options.debug)

    if options.doctest:
        options.pretty = 'no'
        options.console = 'python'

    session = options.console

    if session is not None:
        ipython = session == 'ipython'
    else:
        try:
            import IPython # noqa: F401
            ipython = True
        except ImportError:
            if not options.quiet:
                from sympy.interactive.session import no_ipython
                print(no_ipython)
            ipython = False

    args = {
        'pretty_print': True,
        'use_unicode':  None,
        'use_latex':    None,
        'order':        None,
        'argv':         ipy_args,
    }

    if options.pretty == 'unicode':
        args['use_unicode'] = True
    elif options.pretty == 'ascii':
        args['use_unicode'] = False
    elif options.pretty == 'no':
        args['pretty_print'] = False

    if options.order is not None:
        args['order'] = options.order

    args['quiet'] = options.quiet
    args['auto_symbols'] = options.auto_symbols or options.interactive
    args['auto_int_to_Integer'] = options.auto_int_to_Integer or options.interactive

    from sympy.interactive import init_session
    init_session(ipython, **args)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        issubclass() on the whole MRO of a user class, which may contain protocols.

                not _allow_reckless_class_checks()

    def runtime_checkable(cls):
        """Mark a protocol class as a runtime protocol.

        Such protocol can be used with isinstance() and issubclass().
        Raise TypeError if applied to a non-protocol class.
        This allows a simple-minded structural check very similar to
        one trick ponies in collections.abc such as Iterable.

        For example::

            @runtime_checkable
            class Closable(Protocol):
                def close(self): ...

            assert isinstance(open('/some/file'), Closable)

        not their type signatures!

        if not issubclass(cls, typing.Generic) or not getattr(cls, '_is_protocol', False):
            raise TypeError(f'@runtime_checkable can be only applied to protocol classes,'
                            f' got {cls!r}')

        # because typing.Protocol classes on <=3.11 don't have a
        # `__protocol_attrs__` attribute, and this block relies on the
        # `__protocol_attrs__` attribute. Meanwhile, typing.Protocol classes on 3.12.2+

        # protocol classes have a `__non_callable_proto_members__` attribute

            # with protocols that have non-method members.
            # See gh-113320 for why we compute this attribute here,
            # rather than in `_ProtocolMeta.__init__`
            cls.__non_callable_proto_members__ = set()
            for attr in cls.__protocol_attrs__:
                try:
                    is_callable = callable(getattr(cls, attr, None))
                except Exception as e:
                    raise TypeError(
                        f"Failed to determine whether protocol member {attr!r} "
                        "is a method member"
                    ) from e
                else:
                    if not is_callable:
                        cls.__non_callable_proto_members__.add(attr)

    def get_type_hints(obj, globalns=None, localns=None, include_extras=False):
        """Return type hints for an object.

        This is often the same as obj.__annotations__, but it handles
        forward references encoded as string literals, adds Optional[t] if a

        are returned as a dictionary. For classes, annotations include also
        inherited members.

        annotations, and an empty dictionary is returned if no annotations are

        search order is locals first, then globals.

          globals from obj (or the respective module's globals for classes),
          and these are also used as the locals.  If the object does not appear
          to have globals, an empty dictionary is used.

          locals.

        if not defaults:

        for name, value in hints.items():
            # Not a Union[..., None] or replacement conditions not fullfilled
            if (not _could_be_inserted_optional(value)
                or name not in defaults
                or defaults[name] is not None

                        globalns = getattr(nsobj, '__globals__', {})
                    if localns is None:

                original_value = ForwardRef(
                    original_value,
                    is_argument=not isinstance(obj, _types.ModuleType)

        This supports generic types, Callable, Tuple, Union, Literal, Final, ClassVar

            get_origin(int) is None

            get_origin(Generic) is Generic

            get_origin(List[Tuple[T, T]][int]) == list
            get_origin(P.args) is P

                           ParamSpecArgs, ParamSpecKwargs)):

            get_args(int) == ()

               '''A type-safe decorator to add logging to a function.'''
               def inner(*args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> T:
                   logging.info(f'{f.__name__} was called')
                   return f(*args, **kwargs)

    TypeGuard = typing.TypeGuard
# 3.9
else:
    @_ExtensionsSpecialForm
    def TypeGuard(self, parameters):
        """Special typing form used to annotate the return type of a user-defined
        type guard function.  ``TypeGuard`` only accepts a single type argument.
        At runtime, functions marked this way should return a boolean.

        ``TypeGuard`` aims to benefit *type narrowing* -- a technique used by static
        type checkers to determine a more precise type of an expression within a
        program's code flow.  Usually type narrowing is done by analyzing
        conditional code flow and applying the narrowing to a block of code.  The
        conditional expression here is sometimes referred to as a "type guard".

        Sometimes it would be convenient to use a user-defined boolean function
        as a type guard.  Such a function should use ``TypeGuard[...]`` as its
        return type to alert static type checkers to this intention.

        Using  ``-> TypeGuard`` tells the static type checker that for a given
        function:

        1. The return value is a boolean.
        2. If the return value is ``True``, the type of its argument
        is the type inside ``TypeGuard``.

        For example::

            def is_str(val: Union[str, float]):
                # "isinstance" type guard
                if isinstance(val, str):
                    # Type of ``val`` is narrowed to ``str``
                    ...
                else:
                    # Else, type of ``val`` is narrowed to ``float``.
                    ...

        form of ``TypeA`` (it can even be a wider form) and this may lead to
        type-unsafe results.  The main reason is to allow for things like
        narrowing ``List[object]`` to ``List[str]`` even though the latter is not
        a subtype of the former, since ``List`` is invariant.  The responsibility of
        writing type-safe type guards is left to the user.

        PEP 647 (User-Defined Type Guards).
        """

        return typing._GenericAlias(self, (item,))

_UNPACK_DOC = """\
Type unpack operator.

The type unpack operator takes the child types from some container type,
such as `tuple[int, str]` or a `TypeVarTuple`, and 'pulls them out'. For
example:

  # For some generic class `Foo`:
  Foo[Unpack[tuple[int, str]]]  # Equivalent to Foo[int, str]

  Ts = TypeVarTuple('Ts')
  # Specifies that `Bar` is generic in an arbitrary number of types.
  # (Think of `Ts` as a tuple of an arbitrary number of individual
  #  `TypeVar`s, which the `Unpack` is 'pulling out' directly into the
  #  `Generic[]`.)
  class Bar(Generic[Unpack[Ts]]): ...
  Bar[int]  # Valid
  Bar[int, str]  # Also valid

From Python 3.11, this can also be done using the `*` operator:

    Foo[*tuple[int, str]]
    class Bar(Generic[*Ts]): ...

The operator can also be used along with a `TypedDict` to annotate
`**kwargs` in a function signature. For instance:

  class Movie(TypedDict):
    name: str
    year: int

  # This function expects two keyword arguments - *name* of type `str` and
  # *year* of type `int`.
  def foo(**kwargs: Unpack[Movie]): ...

Note that there is only some runtime checking of this operator. Not
everything the runtime allows may be accepted by static type checkers.

For more information, see PEP 646 and PEP 692.
"""


# PEP 692 changed the repr of Unpack[]
# Breakpoint: https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/104048
if sys.version_info >= (3, 12):
    Unpack = typing.Unpack

    def _is_unpack(obj):
        return get_origin(obj) is Unpack

else:  # <=3.11
    class _UnpackSpecialForm(_ExtensionsSpecialForm, _root=True):
        def __init__(self, getitem):
            super().__init__(getitem)
            self.__doc__ = _UNPACK_DOC

    class _UnpackAlias(typing._GenericAlias, _root=True):
        if sys.version_info < (3, 11):
            # needed for compatibility with Generic[Unpack[Ts]]
            __class__ = typing.TypeVar

        @property
        def __typing_unpacked_tuple_args__(self):
            assert self.__origin__ is Unpack
            assert len(self.__args__) == 1
            arg, = self.__args__
            if isinstance(arg, (typing._GenericAlias, _types.GenericAlias)):
                if arg.__origin__ is not tuple:
                    raise TypeError("Unpack[...] must be used with a tuple type")
                return arg.__args__
            return None

        @property
        def __typing_is_unpacked_typevartuple__(self):
            assert self.__origin__ is Unpack
            assert len(self.__args__) == 1
            return isinstance(self.__args__[0], TypeVarTuple)

        def __getitem__(self, args):
            if self.__typing_is_unpacked_typevartuple__:
                return args
            return super().__getitem__(args)

    @_UnpackSpecialForm
    def Unpack(self, parameters):
        item = typing._type_check(parameters, f'{self._name} accepts only a single type.')
        return _UnpackAlias(self, (item,))

    def _is_unpack(obj):
        return isinstance(obj, _UnpackAlias)


def _unpack_args(*args):
    newargs = []
    for arg in args:
        subargs = getattr(arg, '__typing_unpacked_tuple_args__', None)
        if subargs is not None and (not (subargs and subargs[-1] is ...)):
            newargs.extend(subargs)
        else:
            newargs.append(arg)
    return newargs


if _PEP_696_IMPLEMENTED:
    from typing import TypeVarTuple

elif hasattr(typing, "TypeVarTuple"):  # 3.11+

    # Add default parameter - PEP 696
    class TypeVarTuple(metaclass=_TypeVarLikeMeta):
        """Type variable tuple."""

        _backported_typevarlike = typing.TypeVarTuple

        def __new__(cls, name, *, default=NoDefault):
            tvt = typing.TypeVarTuple(name)
            _set_default(tvt, default)
            _set_module(tvt)

            def _typevartuple_prepare_subst(alias, args):
                params = alias.__parameters__
                typevartuple_index = params.index(tvt)
                for param in params[typevartuple_index + 1:]:
                    if isinstance(param, TypeVarTuple):
                        raise TypeError(
                            f"More than one TypeVarTuple parameter in {alias}"
                        )

                alen = len(args)
                plen = len(params)
                left = typevartuple_index
                right = plen - typevartuple_index - 1
                var_tuple_index = None
                fillarg = None
                for k, arg in enumerate(args):
                    if not isinstance(arg, type):
                        subargs = getattr(arg, '__typing_unpacked_tuple_args__', None)
                        if subargs and len(subargs) == 2 and subargs[-1] is ...:
                            if var_tuple_index is not None:
                                raise TypeError(
                                    "More than one unpacked "
                                    "arbitrary-length tuple argument"
                                )
                            var_tuple_index = k
                            fillarg = subargs[0]
                if var_tuple_index is not None:
                    left = min(left, var_tuple_index)
                    right = min(right, alen - var_tuple_index - 1)
                elif left + right > alen:
                    raise TypeError(f"Too few arguments for {alias};"
                                    f" actual {alen}, expected at least {plen - 1}")
                if left == alen - right and tvt.has_default():
                    replacement = _unpack_args(tvt.__default__)
                else:
                    replacement = args[left: alen - right]

                return (
                    *args[:left],
                    *([fillarg] * (typevartuple_index - left)),
                    replacement,
                    *([fillarg] * (plen - right - left - typevartuple_index - 1)),
                    *args[alen - right:],
                )

            tvt.__typing_prepare_subst__ = _typevartuple_prepare_subst
            return tvt

        def __init_subclass__(self, *args, **kwds):
            raise TypeError("Cannot subclass special typing classes")

else:  # <=3.10
    class TypeVarTuple(_DefaultMixin):
        """Type variable tuple.

        Usage::

            Ts = TypeVarTuple('Ts')

        In the same way that a normal type variable is a stand-in for a single
        type such as ``int``, a type variable *tuple* is a stand-in for a *tuple*
        type such as ``Tuple[int, str]``.

        Type variable tuples can be used in ``Generic`` declarations.
        Consider the following example::

            class Array(Generic[*Ts]): ...

        The ``Ts`` type variable tuple here behaves like ``tuple[T1, T2]``,
        where ``T1`` and ``T2`` are type variables. To use these type variables
        as type parameters of ``Array``, we must *unpack* the type variable tuple using
        the star operator: ``*Ts``. The signature of ``Array`` then behaves
        as if we had simply written ``class Array(Generic[T1, T2]): ...``.
        In contrast to ``Generic[T1, T2]``, however, ``Generic[*Shape]`` allows
        us to parameterise the class with an *arbitrary* number of type parameters.

        Type variable tuples can be used anywhere a normal ``TypeVar`` can.
        This includes class definitions, as shown above, as well as function
        signatures and variable annotations::

            class Array(Generic[*Ts]):

                def __init__(self, shape: Tuple[*Ts]):
                    self._shape: Tuple[*Ts] = shape

                def get_shape(self) -> Tuple[*Ts]:
                    return self._shape

            shape = (Height(480), Width(640))
            x: Array[Height, Width] = Array(shape)
            y = abs(x)  # Inferred type is Array[Height, Width]
            z = x + x   #        ...    is Array[Height, Width]
            x.get_shape()  #     ...    is tuple[Height, Width]

        """

        # Trick Generic __parameters__.
        __class__ = typing.TypeVar

        def __iter__(self):
            yield self.__unpacked__

        def __init__(self, name, *, default=NoDefault):
            self.__name__ = name
            _DefaultMixin.__init__(self, default)

            # for pickling:
            def_mod = _caller()
            if def_mod != 'typing_extensions':
                self.__module__ = def_mod

            self.__unpacked__ = Unpack[self]

        def __repr__(self):
            return self.__name__

        def __hash__(self):
            return object.__hash__(self)

        def __eq__(self, other):
            return self is other

        def __reduce__(self):
            return self.__name__

        def __init_subclass__(self, *args, **kwds):
            if '_root' not in kwds:
                raise TypeError("Cannot subclass special typing classes")


if hasattr(typing, "reveal_type"):  # 3.11+
    reveal_type = typing.reveal_type
else:  # <=3.10
    def reveal_type(obj: T, /) -> T:
        """Reveal the inferred type of a variable.

        When a static type checker encounters a call to ``reveal_type()``,
        it will emit the inferred type of the argument::

            x: int = 1
            reveal_type(x)

        Running a static type checker (e.g., ``mypy``) on this example
        will produce output similar to 'Revealed type is "builtins.int"'.

        At runtime, the function prints the runtime type of the
        argument and returns it unchanged.

        """
        print(f"Runtime type is {type(obj).__name__!r}", file=sys.stderr)
        return obj
